POLICY-01-ROUTINE: Routine claims under limit with no history require no approval.
POLICY-02-REVIEW: Claims with recent history or moderate value require single manager approval.
POLICY-03-HIGH-RISK: High value claims or extensive history require four-eyes executive approval.
POLICY-04-LIMITS: Customers exceeding the maximum lifetime refund count (4) are declined.
POLICY-05-FRAUD: Any account flagged for fraud is automatically declined.
